result.summary: Found 3 issues, including a critical text overlap bug and layout cropping issues affecting the card list.

issues.description: Text overlap in 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card where '25-30' delivery time overlaps with '€0 delivery' text, making it unreadable ('25-3€0delivery')
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout to ensure delivery time and delivery cost text elements do not overlap; add proper spacing or separate them into distinct lines

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only partial content
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll/carousel padding so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability with a partial preview intentionally, and ensure text isn't truncated awkwardly

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with no restaurant name or details visible
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content area so cards aren't obscured by the fixed navigation bar
